items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar. Bei Versand mit der Post ist der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Friday 20.11.2026 (day of posting). Letter states Bekanntgabe occurs on the 4th day after posting. Counting the day after posting as day 1 (§187 Abs.1 BGB analogue): 21.11 (Sat)=1, 22.11 (Sun)=2, 23.11 (Mon)=3, 24.11 (Tue)=4 → Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = 24.11.2026, a regular weekday, no weekend/holiday shift needed. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs from that event under §187 Abs.1/§188 Abs.2 BGB (analogously applied via §37 SGB X procedure): the day of the triggering event itself is not counted, but the period ends on the day of the following month whose calendar number matches the day of the triggering event (24th) → 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is not a statutory public holiday in NRW (only 25./26.12 are), so the deadline stands at 24.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states the postal delivery fiction as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post' (4 days), whereas the standard statutory delivery fiction for benefit decisions under §37 Abs. 2 SGB X is normally 3 days — double-check which rule actually applies to your Familienkasse's Bescheid, as this affects the exact start of the one-month Widerspruch period.

The application for 'Leistungen für Bildung und Teilhabe' mentioned in the letter has no stated deadline, so no due date could be computed for it; you should ask your Kommune whether a time limit applies.
